name: Republic of Finland

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 304,000 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 5,646,436. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 23,850 active incl. conscripts in service. CIA Factbook 2025: ~31,000 incl. ~21,000 conscripts (high).

trainedReserves.note: IISS as quoted: 233,000 reserves (low). Finnish Defence Forces article: wartime strength 280,000 (mid); total trained reserve ~870,000 (high).

supportPersonnel.note: Active 23,850 minus infantry P roles (8,000). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to the Winter and Continuation Wars (~530,000 mobilized from ~3.7 million in 1944, ~14%); today universal conscription keeps a 280,000 wartime army and ~870,000 trained reservists from ~5.6 million.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 251,921,623,482 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 5,646,436 = 44,616. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 314,705,338,515 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 251,921,623,482 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.57% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 2.18% in 2024, 1.30% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 22.5% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Recomputed 2026-10-29 under the definition: 0.05 -> 0.96. Formula: surplus = 1 - a/s, a = farm population share of consumers (proxy: agricultural employment share, World Bank SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, ILO modelled, https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/FIN/indicator/SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS), s = domestic production / consumption (calorie self-sufficiency). a = 3.49% (2025). s from FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets (https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/FoodBalanceSheets_E_All_Data.zip): production / domestic supply summed over all FBS items, each weighted by kcal per tonne (world median of food kcal / food tonnes per item); feed, processing and non-food uses stay in domestic supply. s = 0.84 (mean 2021-2023, range 0.74-0.93). Mid 1 - 0.035/0.84 = 0.96. Low: a x 1.5 (farm households larger than the employed count), s 0.74 = 0.93. High: s 0.93 = 0.96. Import dependence: domestic production covers about 84% of domestic calorie supply. Earlier net-trade reading: Educated guess. Roughly self-sufficient in cereals and dairy; mandatory strategic stockpiles.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 2,792,143 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 5.930% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 33,114. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Patria Hameenlinna AMV/6x6 (CAVS programme with Latvia, Sweden, Germany). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Finnish_Army)

roadKm.note: As quoted: 454,000 km incl. private/forest roads, 78,000 paved (2019).

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 5,918 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

merchantTonnage.note: UNCTAD 2025 as quoted: 1,005 thousand DWT under the Finnish flag.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.3: forests and lakes, deep wilderness, harsh winter the invader is not adapted to, total-defence population support (Winter War precedent).

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:FIN incl. Aland. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Finnish Army equipment list, active Finnish military aircraft list and Finnish Defence Forces article; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Finland's real strength is the 280,000 wartime army, captured by trainedReserves and mobilizationRatio, not by peacetime active.
